An address above the ordinary

Unparalleled
Urban Living

Perched on the 42nd floor of The Meridian, this full-floor penthouse offers 270-degree panoramic views of the city skyline, harbor, and mountains beyond.

Designed by award-winning architect Elena Vasquez, every detail reflects meticulous craftsmanship — from the Italian marble floors to the custom walnut cabinetry. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood 3,800 sq ft of living space with natural light from sunrise to sunset.
